titleEn: It's Okay to Cry Inside My Wings!

pages.text: Peep, peep! Little brother Mumu sat on the stream bank, playing his straw flute. The spring stream sparkled past. Tonight he would play it for Mom.
As Mumu hopped up, his foot slipped on the bank. Thump! Onto his bottom. The flute dropped from his wing, and the current swept it away. "My flute..." His eyes followed it.
Tears were ready to burst, but Mumu held them back. "Crying... is for babies." Behind the willow, he pressed his beak shut. Big sister Dodo looked around. "Mumu, where are you?"
Mom from the mill peeped behind the willow. "Here you are. Your flute floated away, right?" Her long neck curved around the trunk to reach him.
Mom lowered her neck to his eye level. "You're upset because the flute went away. That feeling is sadness. When you're sad, it's okay to cry. Crying isn't shameful." His beak trembled.

Mom spread both wings wide. "Come in here. Cry as much as you need." Mumu slipped inside, opened his beak wide, and cried. "Waaah!" Mom rested her beak on his head. "It's okay to cry inside my wings!"
After a long cry, his chest felt clear. Mumu peeped up. "I'm done crying. I'm okay now." Mom gently preened his damp cheek feathers with her beak.
"Mumu, look!" Water dripped from Dodo's long wing. She had fetched the flute from the stepping stones downstream. Mumu held it in his wing and played. Peep! Sound again! He flicked his tail.

Three things for sadness. "One, come out, don't hide! Two, say, 'I'm sad!' Three, cry all I need inside the wings!" A few days later, something upset him. He went to Mom first. "Mom, I'm sad. Hug me."

Mom wrapped both wings around him and curved her long neck behind his back. "Whenever you want to cry, come inside these wings." Cry instead of holding it in, and your heart feels calm. Mumu peeped out smiling. "It's okay to cry inside my wings!"
